verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents API keys with team-scoped permissions, a team admin role that can revoke other members' keys, and per-machine user access controls for adding or removing team members. The role model is only referenced, keys are scoped at the team level rather than per permission, and no team budget or spend controls are shown. Missing for 10: documented role catalog and member-management workflow, fine-grained per-key permission scopes, team spend or budget controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can manage team members with roles and scoped API keys so credentials and spend stay controlled

citations.quote: API Keys have team-scoped permissions and are associated with your user account.
If you are a team admin, you can also revoke keys that belong to other team members.
Add or remove users to control who can access and administer your machine.
You can revoke your API keys by clicking revoke in the console.
